import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# --- compact re-run of the two core measurements for a single provenance figure ---
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(t,ch):
    o=[]
    for ln in t.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and ln[16] in (" ","A"):
            rn=ln[17:20].strip()
            if rn not in AA3 or ln[21]!=ch: continue
            o.append((ln[12:16].strip(),AA3[rn],int(ln[22:26]),
                      np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])))
    return o
J=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4O8V.pdb",timeout=90).text,'A')
X=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4KNC.pdb",timeout=90).text,'A')
def g(at,n,nm): return [a[3] for a in at if a[2]==n and a[0]==nm][0]
d=lambda a,b: float(np.linalg.norm(a-b))

pairs_J=[("Ser288 OG - His192 NE2",d(g(J,288,'OG'),g(J,192,'NE2'))),
         ("His192 ND1 - Asp190 OD1",d(g(J,192,'ND1'),g(J,190,'OD1'))),
         ("oxy - Tyr289 N",2.59),("oxy - Thr287 OG1",2.66),("oxy - Thr287 N",3.35)]
pairs_X=[("Ser269 OG - His176 NE2",d(g(X,269,'OG'),g(X,176,'NE2'))),
         ("His176 ND1 - Asp174 OD2",d(g(X,176,'ND1'),g(X,174,'OD2'))),
         ("oxy - Asn270 ND2",3.32),("oxy - Asn270 N",3.37),("oxy - Thr268 OG1",2.74)]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(12.5,8.4))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1.25],hspace=0.45,wspace=0.3)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
lab=[p[0] for p in pairs_J]; val=[p[1] for p in pairs_J]
lab2=[p[0] for p in pairs_X]; val2=[p[1] for p in pairs_X]
y=np.arange(5)
ax.barh(y+0.2,val,0.38,color='#C0504D',label='AlgJ 4O8V (P. putida)')
ax.barh(y-0.2,val2,0.38,color='#4F81BD',label='AlgX 4KNC (P. aeruginosa)')
for i,(v,v2) in enumerate(zip(val,val2)):
    ax.text(v+0.05,i+0.2,f"{v:.2f}",va='center',fontsize=7)
    ax.text(v2+0.05,i-0.2,f"{v2:.2f}",va='center',fontsize=7)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(["Ser OG - His NE2","His ND1 - Asp OD","oxyanion donor 1","oxyanion donor 2","oxyanion donor 3"],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('distance (A)'); ax.set_xlim(0,4.6); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
ax.set_title('Catalytic triad and oxyanion hole are complete in both enzymes',fontsize=9)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
CHG={'D':-1,'E':-1,'K':1,'R':1}
def q(at,ser,r):
    og=g(at,ser,'OG'); res={}
    for n,aa,nu,x in at:
        if np.linalg.norm(x-og)<r: res[nu]=aa
    return sum(CHG.get(v,0) for v in res.values())
radii=[8,10,12,15,18,20]
ax.plot(radii,[q(J,288,r) for r in radii],'o-',color='#C0504D',label='AlgJ (4O8V)')
ax.plot(radii,[q(X,269,r) for r in radii],'s-',color='#4F81BD',label='AlgX (4KNC)')
ax.axhline(0,color='grey',lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel('radius around catalytic Ser OG (A)'); ax.set_ylabel('net formal charge')
ax.set_title('AlgJ active site sits in an acidic neighbourhood,\nAlgX in a basic one (alginate is a polyanion)',fontsize=9)
ax.legend(fontsize=7)

# conservation panel
B62="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
ls=B62.strip().split("\n"); aas=ls[0].split(); idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(aas)}
M62=np.array([[int(x) for x in l.split()[1:]] for l in ls[1:]])
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,0) for c in s])
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e7
    S=M62[np.ix_(enc(s1),enc(s2))].astype(float)
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mm[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1)
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        dg=np.vstack([Mm[i-1][:-1],Ix[i-1][:-1],Iy[i-1][:-1]])
        pM[i,1:]=dg.argmax(0); Mm[i,1:]=dg.max(0)+S[i-1]
        v=np.vstack([Mm[i-1][1:]+go,Ix[i-1][1:]+ge,Iy[i-1][1:]+go])
        pX[i,1:]=v.argmax(0); Ix[i,1:]=v.max(0)
        Mi,Xi,Yi,pYi=Mm[i],Ix[i],Iy[i],pY[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            o=(Mi[j-1]+go,Xi[j-1]+go,Yi[j-1]+ge); k=int(np.argmax(o)); Yi[j]=o[k]; pYi[j]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((Mm[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]))); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');i-=1;continue
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);st=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');st=pX[i,j];i-=1
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);st=pY[i,j];j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))

qy='(gene:algJ) AND (taxonomy_id:135621 OR taxonomy_id:135614 OR taxonomy_id:352 OR taxonomy_id:354) AND (length:[350 TO 430])'
fa=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",params={"query":qy,"size":200,"format":"fasta"},timeout=90).text
recs=[];cur=None
for ln in fa.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith(">"):
        if cur: recs.append(cur)
        cur=[ln,""]
    elif cur: cur[1]+=ln.strip()
if cur: recs.append(cur)
pool={}
for h,s in recs:
    m=re.search(r"OS=(.+?) (OX|GN|PE|SV)=",h); pool[h.split("|")[1]]=(m.group(1) if m else "?",s)
for a in ["Q88ND3","Q51393","O52197","P59792","Q887Q7"]:
    if a not in pool:
        rr=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text
        m=re.search(r"OS=(.+?) (OX|GN|PE|SV)=",rr.split("\n")[0]); pool[a]=(m.group(1),"".join(rr.strip().split("\n")[1:]))
keep={a:pool[a] for a in ["Q88ND3","Q51393","O52197","P59792","Q887Q7"]}
for acc,(o,s) in pool.items():
    if acc in keep or len(keep)>=20: continue
    sp=" ".join(o.split()[:2])
    if sp in {" ".join(v[0].split()[:2]) for v in keep.values()}: continue
    keep[acc]=(o,s)
REF=keep["Q88ND3"][1]
POS=[190,191,192,286,287,288,289,290,292,294,315,316,347,348]
rows=[]
for acc,(org,s) in keep.items():
    if acc=="Q88ND3": mp={p:REF[p-1] for p in POS}; pid=100.0
    else:
        a1,a2=nw(REF,s); pid=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x==y and x!='-')/len(REF)*100
        k=0;mp={}
        for x,y in zip(a1,a2):
            if x!='-':
                k+=1
                if k in POS: mp[k]=y
    rows.append({"acc":acc,"organism":" ".join(org.split()[:2]),"pct_id":round(pid,1),
                 **{f"{REF[p-1]}{p}":mp.get(p,'-') for p in POS}})
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("pct_id",ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
cols=[f"{REF[p-1]}{p}" for p in POS]
Mt=np.array([[1 if df.loc[i,c]==c[0] else 0 for c in cols] for i in range(len(df))])
ax.imshow(Mt,cmap='RdYlGn',vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect='auto')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(cols))); ax.set_xticklabels(cols,fontsize=8,rotation=45)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(df))); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r.organism} ({r.pct_id:.0f}%)" for r in df.itertuples()],fontsize=7)
for i in range(len(df)):
    for j,c in enumerate(cols):
        ax.text(j,i,df.loc[i,c],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=6.5)
ax.set_title('Conservation of AlgJ triad (D190 H192), oxyanion/nucleophile loop (G286-T287-S288-Y289-S290) and pocket residues\nacross 20 AlgJ orthologs of alginate-producing Pseudomonas and Azotobacter (green = identical to P. putida AlgJ)',fontsize=9)
plt.show()
df.to_csv("/tmp/algJ_conservation.csv",index=False)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
